en-US.story.warden.intro.elder: The lanterns still burn. That means the valley is still waiting for a witness.
en-US.story.warden.intro.shrine: Wake the shrine, face what it sends, and bring me back a judgment worth keeping.
en-US.story.warden.briefing.001: The Ember Shrine keeps count of every oath we break. Step close and choose how you want to enter the trial.
en-US.story.player.briefing.lore: Tell me what the shrine remembers.
en-US.story.player.briefing.accept_now: I am ready. Open the path.
en-US.story.warden.briefing.lore_reply: Then listen well: the shrine marks every oath, every mercy, every lie. Carry that ember-memory with you.
en-US.story.player.briefing.accept_after_lore: Then let the shrine judge me.
en-US.story.warden.briefing.accept: Go to the shrine. Wake what sleeps beneath it, and return when you can name what should survive.
en-US.story.shrine.reveal.001: The shrine cracks. Heat rolls out across the flagstones.
en-US.story.warden.return.001: You came back alive. Now answer plainly: what should this valley remember from the Ashen Beast?
en-US.story.player.return.duty: Seal the story. Let duty keep the valley safe.
en-US.story.player.return.mercy: Remember it. Fear without memory will only grow back.
en-US.story.warden.return.duty_outro: Then the valley keeps its ward, and you leave it stronger than you found it.
en-US.story.warden.return.mercy_outro: Then the valley keeps a memory instead of a scar.

zh-CN.story.warden.intro.elder: 灯火仍在燃烧。这说明山谷仍在等待一位见证者。
zh-CN.story.warden.intro.shrine: 唤醒神龛，面对它派出的存在，再带给我一个值得铭记的裁决。
zh-CN.story.warden.briefing.001: 余烬神龛会记下我们打破的每一份誓言。靠近它，并选择你进入试炼的方式。
zh-CN.story.warden.briefing.lore_reply: 那就仔细听：神龛铭记每一份誓言、每一次仁慈、每一个谎言。把那份余烬记忆带在身上。
zh-CN.story.warden.briefing.accept: 去神龛。唤醒沉睡其下的东西，等你能说出什么应当留下时再回来。
zh-CN.story.shrine.reveal.001: 神龛开裂。热浪翻过石板。
zh-CN.story.warden.return.001: 你活着回来了。现在直说：这座山谷该从灰烬兽身上记住什么？
zh-CN.story.player.return.duty: 封存这段故事。让职责守住山谷。
zh-CN.story.player.return.mercy: 记住它。没有记忆的恐惧只会再次生长。
zh-CN.story.warden.return.duty_outro: 那么山谷守住它的防线，你留下的比你找到时更坚固。
zh-CN.story.warden.return.mercy_outro: 那么山谷留下的是记忆，而不是伤疤。
